# user-config

An OpenCode 2.4.1 configuration as people really have it, in `opencode.jsonc`:
comments, trailing commas, `$schema`, settings the adapter does not know, the
person's own MCP servers (one with an `{env:…}` header, one `disabled`), own
skill, own slash command and own agent, and the credentials OpenCode keeps in
its data directory. None of it may change, except for the entries the sync adds
next to the person's own servers.
